name: Tellura
tagline: Dirt has opinions. We translate them.
positioning: Enterprise soil intelligence that turns core samples and sensor feeds into decisions your agronomists will actually defend in a boardroom.

hero.h1: Your soil is lying to your spreadsheet.
hero.sub: Tellura ingests core samples, probe telemetry, and lab panels across every parcel you manage — then hands your team one number they can bet the harvest on.

features.title: Every core, one truth
features.description: Reconcile lab panels, in-field probes, and legacy PDFs into a single parcel-level model. No more three agronomists arguing about which nitrogen reading is real.

features.title: Boardroom-grade reports
features.description: Export soil health scorecards that a CFO reads without flinching. Confidence intervals included, jargon quietly removed.

features.title: Drift alerts that fire early
features.description: Get pinged when pH, salinity, or organic carbon wanders off its baseline — weeks before it shows up in yield.

features.title: Ground truth by acre
features.description: Map results to exact coordinates, not vague zones. Your variable-rate rig gets instructions it can follow.

features.title: Audit trail for regulators
features.description: Every sample timestamped, chain-of-custody logged, and exportable for carbon and sustainability filings.

features.title: Plugs into what you run
features.description: Feeds John Deere Operations Center, Climate FieldView, and your ERP without a six-month integration slog.

testimonials.quote: We were making million-dollar amendment calls off a shared spreadsheet nobody trusted. Tellura gave us one soil model and, weirdly, our agronomists stopped emailing at midnight.
testimonials.name: Dana Holcombe

testimonials.quote: The drift alerts caught a salinity creep on our east blocks before it cost us the season. That single warning paid for the contract twice.
testimonials.name: Rafael Ortega

testimonials.quote: Our sustainability filing used to take a quarter and a lot of prayer. Now the chain-of-custody data exports itself. The auditors were almost disappointed.
testimonials.name: Priya Sundaram

pricing.blurb: For operations getting off spreadsheets and onto a real soil model.
For multi-parcel enterprises that need alerts before problems bloom.
For portfolios spanning regions, labs, and jurisdictions.

homepage.footerBlurb: Tellura turns the dirt under your operation into decisions you can defend. Soil analytics for people who own the outcome.
